zh: a traditional story found in many European countries. A girl called Little Red Riding Hood goes to visit her grandmother in the forest, but when she arrives a wolf (= a wild animal like a large dog) has eaten her grandmother and put on her clothes. Little Red Riding Hood is surprised at the appearance of her grandmother and says, ‘Grandmother, what big eyes you have!’ ‘All the better to see you with,’ replies the wolf. ‘Grandmother, what big teeth you have!’ says the girl. ‘All the better to eat you with,’ replies the wolf, and eats her. Little Red Riding Hood and her grandmother are saved when a hunter cuts open the wolf's stomach and they escape.
en: a traditional story found in many European countries. A girl called Little Red Riding Hood goes to visit her grandmother in the forest, but when she arrives a wolf (= a wild animal like a large dog) has eaten her grandmother and put on her clothes. Little Red Riding Hood and her grandmother are saved when a hunter cuts open the wolf's stomach and they escape.

zh: 小石城（美国阿肯色州首府和最大城市）
en: the capital and largest city of the US state of Arkansas. It is an industrial centre on the Arkansas River. It became known around the world in 1957 when President Eisenhower sent US Army forces there to protect African Americans who wanted to attend city schools with white people. This caused a lot of violence. Bill Clinton later lived in Little Rock as the governor of Arkansas (1978-80 and 1982-90) before he became President.

zh: a very popular US book (1868-9) written mainly for girls by Louisa May Alcott. The story, based on that of her own family, is about the March family of four sisters, living in New England in the 19th century. The girls are Meg, Jo, Beth and Amy. Film versions were made in 1933 with Katharine Hepburn, 1949 with Elizabeth Taylor, and 1994 with Winona Ryder. Alcott wrote two further books with the same characters: Little Men (1871) and Jo's Boys (1886).

zh: the fact of being not important or not powerful
the fact of being too concerned about things that are not important and unable to understand the things that are
小的；比较小的
en: the fact of being not important or not powerful
ex: We are aware of our littleness in the scheme of things.
我们意识到我们在事物计划方面的不足。

ex: littoral states

zh: 礼拜仪式

zh: 礼拜仪式
en: in a way that is connected with liturgy (= the fixed form of public worship used in churches)

zh: 礼拜仪式
en: a fixed form of prayers and actions used in public worship in some religions, especially Christianity
ex: Henry VIII ordered that the English Prayer Book was to replace the old Latin liturgy in church services.
亨利八世下令，教堂礼拜时要用英语祈祷书代替原先的拉丁文祈祷书。

zh: a first name for girls, short for Olivia
en: a first name for girls, short for Olivia

zh: 适于居住的
值得一过的
能对付；可处理
足够维持生活的
en: fit to live in
ex: safer and more livable residential areas
更安全更适合居住的住宅区

zh: （电影中的）真人实拍片段
en: part of a film that is made using real people or animals, rather than using drawings, models or computers

zh: two very large pop concerts held at the same time in London, and Philadelphia, US, in 1985. The aim of the concerts was to encourage people to give money to help people dying of hunger in Africa and £150 million was given. The concerts were organized by Bob Geldof. Live 8, a second series of concerts, took place in 2005.

zh: 直播博客；实时博客（或微博客）
en: a blog or a microblog on which a description of an event is given as it takes place

zh: 按照（某信念或原则）生活
en: to follow a particular belief or set of principles
ex: That's a philosophy I could live by.
那就是我所信奉的人生哲学。

zh: 靠做某事赚钱为生（或获取所需）
en: to earn money or to get the things you need by doing a particular thing
ex: a community that lives by fishing
靠捕鱼为生的群体

zh: 能使人忘却（做过的令人尴尬的事）
en: to be able to make people forget about something embarrassing you have done
ex: She felt so stupid. She'd never be able to live it down.
她觉得自己做了傻事，恐怕永远无法挽回自己的面子了。

zh: the broadcast of sound or video over the internet from a live (not recorded) source, for example a concert or sports event
en: the broadcast of sound or video over the internet from a live (not recorded) source, for example a concert or sports event
ex: We watched live feeds from the International Space Station.
我们观看了国际空间站的现场直播。

zh: 以…为主要生活目的；为…而活着
en: to think that somebody/something is the main purpose of or the most important thing in your life
ex: She lives for her work.
她活着是为了工作。

zh: 住在工作（或学习）的地方
en: to live at the place where you work or study
ex: They have an au pair living in.
他们有个互惠女生住在家里。

zh: 靠…过活；依赖…生活
以吃…为生
en: to receive the money you need to live from somebody/something because you do not have any yourself
ex: She's still living off her parents.
她还在靠父母养活。

zh: 继续活着；继续存在
以吃…为生
仅以（一种食物）为主要食物
靠（…钱）生活
en: to continue to live or exist
ex: She died ten years ago but her memory lives on.
她十年前就去世了，但她还留在人们的记忆中。

zh: 不住在工作（或学习）的地方
实践（以前想要做的事）
（以某种方式）度过余生
en: to live away from the place where you work or study
ex: Some college students will have to live out.
有些大学生将不得不住在校外。

zh: 网络直播；实况流播
en: a live broadcast of an event over the internet
ex: We saw the live stream.
我们看到了直播。
